'''Hurd Coyle''' was a junk [[Scavenger/Legends|salvager]]. Following the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]], Captain Coyle rescued the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[HOB-147]] who was drifting in space and had missed [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. The clone's damaged [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|fighter]] was brought onboard [[Hurd Coyle's ship|Coyle's ship]] and he was taken to the sickbay by his reprogrammed [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]].

[[File:HurdCoylesShip-Salvaged.jpg|thumb|left|Hurd Coyle's ship encounters HOB-147's starfighter drifting in space.]]
When HOB-147 woke, he attacked the battle droid thinking that he had been captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. When Coyle walked into the sickbay he stunned the clone with an [[electro-dart]] and chained him to a wall. The clone was left alone, allowing him to rip the metal chain from the wall. He walked through the ship, until he encountered a group of Jedi [[Youngling/Legends|Younglings]] that Hurd was transporting including [[Nia]], who he had met earlier, and [[Bon (Jedi)|Bon]].

When Coyle's ship was subsequently boarded by a group of clone troopers led by an [[Unidentified ARC trooper commander|ARC trooper commander]], HOB-147 told the commander that the Coyle had saved his life and that there were no Jedi aboard. The commander believed the pilot's lie and ordered his men back to their ship, sparing Coyle.
